ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with a dominant high-intensity white interior (approx. 85%) bounded by low-intensity black perimeter regions (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel region covering central lobes. Low-intensity black banding along trailing edge and outer tips. Small discrete black pixel clusters (diameter <10px) on the proximal-lateral region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approx 120 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows high-amplitude (10-30px) irregular jagged peaks. Right lobe trailing edge shows lower-amplitude (<10px) regular serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a convex curve towards the tips. Trailing edges follow a predominantly concave trajectory meeting at the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, light-colored circular/conical pixel clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct dark vertical linear feature on the left lobe, approximately 30 pixels in length, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge contour on the left lobe suggesting past tissue loss. Dense clusters of foreign bodies (barnacles) on lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical barnacle clusters on both lobe tips providing high-contrast texture against the dark edge.
